ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) central isosceles-shaped region surrounded by high-intensity (white/light gray) peripheral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region (approx. 50% surface area) is solid black. Left lobe displays diffuse black mottling and vertical streaking on a light gray base. Right lobe displays three prominent, high-contrast vertical black bars and sparse mottling on a bright white base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an estimated pixel interior angle of 85-90 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable higher-amplitude 'peaks' and 'valleys' are visible on the distal thirds of both the left and right lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edges transitioning to acute, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast dark pixel clusters with 3D texture (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) are clearly visible, particularly on the right lobe's white surface and the upper section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular 'ragged' appearance of the trailing edge with multiple small notches; heavy bio-fouling/barnacle accumulation at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'piano key' vertical black bar pattern on the right lobe and a singular white circular spot on the black central region (right side).
